authorshipAndDerivation.kind: one new imagegen-authored coherent material per canonical topic
authorshipAndDerivation.artAllowed: Material appearance comes from preserved imagegen sources. Bounded edge matching and mask/UV composition from those textures is within the stated task scope.
authorshipAndDerivation.artNotAllowed: Do not paint procedural dirt, stones, ruts, grain, cracks, embers, or replacement texture detail in code. Do not reuse completed environment material pixels under new canonical names.
authorshipAndDerivation.sourceWindows: Keep historical source windows as provenance; new generated-source windows are independently measured and registered. One common physical/logical material scale per topic; no per-mask zooms.

defectDisposition.issue: Nonmatching RGB boundaries in all four topics at both densities
defectDisposition.method: Author a coherent periodic imagegen material, then use only bounded source-texture edge matching/UV composition. Compare every allowed adjacent output pair. Preserve generated texture as the appearance source.
defectDisposition.no: No procedural texture painting or fake detailed noise

defectDisposition.issue: BORDER2/4 diagonal rut stripes clipped identically into all cardinal paths
defectDisposition.method: New material must keep mud/puddle/cart-impression identity with locally complete, subdued marks that do not imply incompatible route direction. If directional continuity needs arm-local UV composition, document transforms at one scale and verify all sixteen masks.
defectDisposition.no: Do not add routes, widen gameplay passage, or create new mask identities

defectDisposition.issue: Generic NESW alpha topology in first family
defectDisposition.method: No technical occupancy defect found: N/E/S/W bit contract, core, arm widths and edge spans match across all masks at both densities. Use exact supplied alpha arrays/shapes.
defectDisposition.no: Do not redesign mask0 as empty, reorder masks, silently soften/widen connections, or substitute environment route masks

defectDisposition.issue: Legacy four overlapping source windows lose source-wide compositions
defectDisposition.method: One newly authored material per topic, four mechanical variant windows for BORDER1/3. Preserve complete local straw/char motifs in interiors and make edge signatures agree using bounded texture composition.
defectDisposition.no: Do not claim four separate authored sources or carry unsafe automatic 0.62 cropping into new sources without review

defectDisposition.method: It is necessary to reproduce old pixels for audit, not a mandatory treatment for already-approved new material. Register any new export transforms explicitly and keep source appearance faithful.
defectDisposition.no: Do not blindly recolor the approved source to mimic the old detailed style

defectDisposition.issue: Later-family shoreline, bridge, root, grave-circle and oath-hub fragmentation
defectDisposition.method: Try complete source-grounded local motifs designed for the retained tile/core envelope and documented texture UV composition. If identity cannot survive, report the exact conflict; do not manufacture new topology to claim completion.

acceptance: Both 1x and 2x sheet dimensions and mode metadata unchanged
For each connected tile, alpha matches the exact baseline mask at that density, including all closed edges and open 8px/16px spans
Opaque variants have alpha=255 everywhere; connected strips have real alpha=0 outside mask, never painted checkerboards

Texture seams: compare every a/b/c/d E-W and S-N pairing; compare all open connected-edge pairings; shared border signature obtained from bounded source-texture edge matching/UV composition, not painted procedural detail, and verified in deliverable
Review 2x2 identical and 4x4 mixed opaque tilings; connected isolated/end/straight/corner/T/cross fixtures; native 32px cell scale plus 2x inspection
Source-grounded motif review against exact source slots, plus approved-v5 actor/material cohesion fixture
Formal catalog registration and HD resolver tests; keep gameplay status catalog-only unless a separate existing consumer is explicitly bound
Count4canonical identities only after raw/export/formal-catalog stages pass; no environment increment and no live-game assertion
